basic_info.description: This unit is a 1 bedroom 1 bath luxury condo located at the prestigious Millennium Tower in the heart of downtown San Francisco.  The kitchen offers full gas ranges, built-in Sub Zero refrigerator, and Bosch built in oven.  Kitchen countertop doubles as a bar counter. Over/under washer and dryer is stored in a laundry room. The single bathroom in this unit has a large soaking tub.  Utility/broom closet at entrance and pantry/storage rooms in the living room and kitchen area.  Built in retractable shade is in both the living room and bedroom. The bedroom window opens along with a ledge in the bedroom window for reading/sitting.  In-unit HVAC provides heat and AC for comfort year round.  Large living room and bedroom windows provides city & bay views.      Included resident amenities are extensive:  24/7 Security, concierge, valet, amenities, clubhouse, resident wine cellar, movie theater, dinning room, cafe, indoor/outdoor lounge area, pool, gym, indoor child play area to name a few.  Resident social events are planned by a dedicated clubhouse management.  All the convenience, luxury, amenities, service, located right inside the building.  Fantastic opportunity to live or invest in one of the tallest, most luxurious, full amenity buildings in San Francisco!
